evidence.claim: ContextBudgetReceipt is emitted per run at the host edge measuring installed graph size, actual model-visible rule/skill/tool/MCP/subagent schema and input tokens with a measurement source; cold/inactive context is excluded.
evidence.proof: packages/kernel/src/northstar/context-budget.ts buildContextBudgetReceipt + estimateInstalledGraph; wired into runtime.ts writing .agent/runs/<run>/context-budget-receipt.json.
